violations.why: After line 22 meadow is enabled and can preempt the task between the check and the reset, so the reset overwrites its increment.
Meadow's enable_isr(2) leaves nectar enabled, so it can run between the check and the reset and its update is lost.
Before the task masks interrupts, vessel can preempt between the rand() store and the later check, so the check sees a value the task did not write.
Nectar can preempt between the store at 31 and the read at 23 and change the value.
Meadow can preempt between the store at 31 and the read at 23 and change the value.
Vessel has higher priority and can preempt meadow's non-atomic increment, so its update is lost.
Vessel can preempt nectar's non-atomic += and its update is lost.
